import os, sys, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

class AccessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        initialize(self.c)
        rows = [
            (1, "t", "o", "A", "a", None),
            (2, "t", "o", "B", "b", "2026-01-01"),
            (3, "x", "o", "C", "c", None),
            (4, "t", "p", "D", "d", None),
            (5, "t", "o'brien", "E\"q", "e", None),
            (6, "t", "o", "F", "f", None),
        ]
        self.c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
        self.c.commit()

    def tearDown(self):
        self.c.close()

    def test_get_document_visible(self):
        self.assertEqual(get_document(self.c, "t", "o", 1), {"id": 1, "title": "A", "body": "a"})

    def test_get_document_hidden_cases_return_none(self):
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "x", "o", 1))   # cross-tenant
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "t", "p", 1))   # cross-owner
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "t", "o", 2))   # deleted
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "t", "o", 99))  # missing

    def test_get_document_quote_in_owner_is_bound(self):
        self.assertEqual(get_document(self.c, "t", "o'brien", 5), {"id": 5, "title": 'E"q', "body": "e"})
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.c, "t", "o' OR '1'='1", 1))

    def test_list_documents_filters_and_orders(self):
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "t", "o"), [
            {"id": 1, "title": "A", "body": "a"},
            {"id": 6, "title": "F", "body": "f"},
        ])

    def test_list_documents_quote_and_injection_are_bound(self):
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "t", "o' OR '1'='1"), [])
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.c, "t", "o'brien"), [{"id": 5, "title": 'E"q', "body": "e"}])

    def test_result_fields_exact(self):
        for doc in list_documents(self.c, "t", "o"):
            self.assertEqual(set(doc), {"id", "title", "body"})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
